purpose: Use one telling detail as evidence for a wider judgment.
keywords: Even the entrance of this shop is stylish.
His explanation is wrong from its very premise.
Judging even by its name, the dish sounds spicy.
restrictions: Often means even this starting detail, suggesting more follows.
mistake: Do not assume the single example proves every wider claim.
